name: Men's Kou
summary:
Seihou Private High School, also known as Alcatraz, is a 35-year-old prestigious boarding high school. The school is located on a remote island and can only be visited by boat twice a day and almost impossible by foot. The environment seems perfect for school as students cannot do anything except concentrating on their studies. However, a group of friends became upset that they will be losing their youths and try to get away and find freedom.

Adapted from the manga "Seiho High School Men's!!!" (メンズ校) by Izumi Kaneyoshi (和泉かねよし)

name: Gangnam B-Side
summary: A pariah detective is pulled back into the game after his daughter's friend goes missing. The latest in a long line of women to go missing in the Gangnam area of Seoul, the detective delves back into a world of vice, drugs and corruption to uncover something that threatens to topple some of the city's wealthiest elite.

name: Half CA
summary: Two CA Aspirants from two different ends of the spectrum of the course, Archie and Niraj embark on the journey of one of the toughest courses and face the obstacles it has to offer.

name: Spider-Noir
summary: Spider-Noir tells the story of Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, who is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

name: Anupama
summary: After a dreamy and 'oh-so-happening' America visit, Anupama returns home. With new challenges and old conflicts to resolve, a new journey awaits her.

name: Dan Abrams Live
summary: Host Dan Abrams brings a fresh, no-holds-barred approach to covering and analyzing the news weeknights.

name: Назад в будущее
summary: The game involves two teams of two people. The game consists of three rounds and a super final for the winning team. Players answer questions related to the years. The team that earns the most money wins.

name: Nečista krv
summary:
Voja Nanovič, the original screenwriter, connected the action of the series as a sublimation of all the novels and short stories of Bora Stankovič into one family saga covering a period of 40 years from the end of the 19th century. Through three generations, Unclean Blood tells the story of the financial, moral and physical decline of a family. The story begins with Hadži Trifun, Sofka's grandfather, and ends with Sofka, i.e. all the characters from Tašana, Paraputa and other works are connected through that one family and people who lived in Vranje.

Tryphon, a wealthy leader of the Christian minority in the Turkish Empire, represents the first generation of the family. He tries to meet the moral standards of society and preserve his wealth and his family's reputation, while at the same time fighting against his erotic urges. In order to maintain his power, Tryphon sets in motion a series of events that will have dire consequences for his family members.

The second generation of the family is represented by Mita, Tryfun's son, who does not want to be part of his father's dirty business empire. Mita belongs to a group of old aristocrats, whose resources are drying up and who are opposed by new, rich profiteers, uneducated and vulgar. After losing all his wealth and possessions, Mita is forced to marry his most beautiful daughter, Sofka, to a rich man in order to survive.

Sofka represents the third generation of the family, which is under complete financial and spiritual decline. Despite being marked by the blood and actions of her ancestors, Sofka tries to rise above the social and historical circumstances of the time in which she lives.

name: Внуки в ауле
summary: Before his death, Zhanbyrbai ata, the elder of the village, a wayward and stubborn grandfather, bequeathed to his second cousins, who had never seen him in their lives, a house, a cow, the dog Aktos and 100 million tenge. The grandchildren will receive a huge inheritance under one condition - they need to live in the village for exactly a year, without leaving its territory for more than 24 hours. In case of an error, all money will be transferred to the account of the local akimat.

What is the daily routine like for an ambulance crew? Viewers can expect an honest and witty story about those who save the lives of Kazakhstanis every day, demonstrating sparkling humor and the ability not to lose heart even in those life situations where there is usually no time for laughter. The characters of the sitcom are a driver, a paramedic and his assistant. Each of them has their own problems and dreams. But their main calling: the ability to quickly make decisions when minutes count.

name: Преподы
summary: The focus is on Marat. He is the most ordinary young man, born and raised in Kazakhstan. Like each of us, he dreams of something and makes plans for the future. Most of all, Marat wants to get settled in life: find a well-paid job, meet the girl of his dreams, marry her, start a strong family. This is how Marat sees the life of an accomplished person. It is not known whether the prospect of teaching at the university was part of Marat's plans, but he still got a job at a higher education institution. Here he met a huge number of new people. Colleagues gradually turn into friends of the newcomer. Life turns upside down. Everything seems to start from scratch...

name: Elle
summary: Elle follows Elle Woods in high school as we learn about the life experiences that shaped her into the iconic young woman we came to know and love in the first Legally Blonde film.

name: Buy It Now
summary: JB Smoove hosts a business competition where entrepreneurs get 90 seconds to pitch their product to an audience of potential customers: The 100. If The 100 like the product and price, then the entrepreneurs go to a panel of Amazon executives and celebrity entrepreneurs. The panel selects which products join Amazon's exclusive Buy It Now Store and award one entrepreneur $20,000 each episode.

name: Wish List Games
summary: Wish List Games is a multi-episode holiday event. Joining Emmy-winner and host Nick Cannon, content creator Lele Pons will be featured on the game show as a special correspondent. Wish List Games is a high-energy, half-hour game show where contestants play for the chance to win everything on their Amazon Wish List, totaling up to $25,000. Every episode, contestants are pulled from the audience to play a rotating series of fun and fantastical games. It all builds to the final round, where one contestant plays to win a prize for everyone in the audience.

previousepisode.name: Will They Win A Tennis Bracelet, Jukebox And Skate Ramp?

name: Anderson Cooper Full Circle
summary: Anderson Cooper anchors this show that provides the news in a fun and interactive ways as viewers get to engage and have a say in the stories that are covered.

name: 5 Things with Kate Bolduan
summary: 5 Things brings you the five essential stories that — in five minutes or less — will get you up to speed and on with your day. Stream itlive or anytime, only on CNN Max.

name: Pop Culture Jeopardy!
summary: Pop Culture Jeopardy! is a brand-new twist on the classic quiz show's "answer-and-question" format that combines the academic rigor of Jeopardy! with the excitement and unpredictability of pop culture. Contestants, playing in teams of three, will need to be experts in categories from Alternative Rock to The Avengers; Broadway to MMA; Gen Z to Zendaya as they compete in a tournament-style event for the grand prize and ultimate bragging rights.

name: The Newscast with Wolf Blitzer
summary: CNN Anchor Wolf Blitzer gives it to you straight, hitting the headlines you need to know on this traditional evening newscast with a sleek, modern twist. The old-school nostalgic approach featuring original reporting from around the world, investigations and consumer focused stories that matter helps put the latest headlines in perspective.

name: Scamanda
summary: Based on the podcast of the same name, Scamanda tells the story of Amanda Riley — a wife, mother, blogger and Christian — whose tragic cancer tale captivates thousands. But Amanda has a secret that she's dying to keep, and after an anonymous tip to an investigative reporter, her own words may prove to be her downfall.

previousepisode.name: Stage 4: Catch Me if You Cancer

name: Parental Guidance with Anderson Cooper
summary: New dad, Anderson Cooper gets parenting advice from experts as he navigates life as a working parent. Anderson confronts everyday challenges from sleep schedules to screen time to audience questions about relatable daily struggles.

name: De pies a Cabeza
summary: El Gato Aguirre, a professional soccer player, who has to abandoned his successful career because of a car accident, he has to go back to the neighborhood that saw him grow as a man and as a soccer player; to dedicate himself to form young soccer players in a soccer school and to succeed with them. In this we find also that Lucia and her son Pablo play and important part. She is a woman, affected by the kidnap and disappearance of her husband, keeps her in a difficult economical and sentimental situation. Pablo, on the other hand, is young, happy, anxious, talented and with a noticeable ability to elude contraries in the soccer field and the reprimands at home. For one of those things in life and soccer, El Gato arrives to live with Lucia and Pablo, to provide us with the more exciting of the impossible loves, and the most amusing encounters. In the middle of the games is Willington Ortiz, a true Latin-American soccer legend who becomes the best friend, counselor, and master of El Gato and its pupils.

name: Jake Tapper's Book Club
summary: Read between the lines with Tapper as he interviews newsmaking authors and a few of his favorite writers. Each week, viewers learn about the stories behind bestselling books and add more to their reading lists along the way.

name: Rex Chapman
summary: He's celebrated the highs of NBA stardom, rebounded from the lows of opioid addiction, and reinvented himself through social media. If anyone can find the silver lining in today's toughest headlines, it's Rex Chapman. He brings heart and positivity to conversations with celebrities, athletes and everyday heroes.

previousepisode.name: Rex and Friend Muggsy Bogues Reminiscence on Time With Hornets

name: The Don Lemon Show
summary: Make your voice heard in Don's weekly talk show as he and his special guests break down the buzziest moments and debate the most provocative stories of the week.

name: Boss Files with Poppy Harlow
summary: What does it take to be the boss? Poppy Harlow gets the answers from the biggest names in business. Sit in on intimate conversations and confessions from today's most influential leaders and learn how personal and professional struggles helped them forge a path to success.

name: Big Picture with Sara Sidner
summary: An in-depth look at the most important and interesting story of the day, hosted by Sara Sidner. Sidner hosts a deep-dive conversation featuring reporters and expert guests. Zoom out and contemplate the broader scope of today's top story and how various pieces of the puzzle connect.

name: Café
summary: Teresa Suárez, nicknamed "Gaviota" (Spanish for "Gull"), and her mother Carmenza Suárez, work as harvesters and throughout the year they travel to different farmlands across Colombia searching for work. One, October Gaviota meets Sebastián Vallejo, the grandson of the owner of the farmlands where they work. They fall deeply in love with each other and plan to be together even if it means going against his family's will, but eventually destiny separates them and they must overcome many obstacles to find their way back together.

name: Momposina
summary:
This series that initially takes place in 1920 tells the story of the deep and eternal love between Rosa Lenoit "La Momposina" and Alejandro Molinares, as well as the confrontation between their two cities, Santa Cruz de Mompos and Nuestra Señora de La Candelaria del Banco, both located on the banks of the Magdalena River in the Colombian tropics. Without meeting Alejandro yet, in Mompos, Rosa is pressured by her parents to accept Captain Rito Perilla as a boyfriend, a man much older than her who is truly in love and has also promised the girl's father, General Trinidad Lenoit, settle in this port with his steamboat company if she becomes his wife.

On the other hand, at the Bank, Alejandro's father, "El Galeno" Molinares, a man with great vision, insists on turning his population into the most advanced of his time in the country, always wanting to overshadow the successes of the Lenoit family. To this end, he builds a theater to represent opera, and associates with the German Hindenbur to bring a seaplane and thus inaugurate the first aviation company in the country. Alejandro, for his part, only observes the activities of his father without paying much attention to them. His job is to make all the women of the town fall in love and go from party to party with his friends. But one day his life changes when he meets Coralina, the beautiful dancer who comes to town with a French opera company and with whom he flees the town to marry. But one day, after each one has formalized their relationship, fate unites Rosa and Alejandro. Together they know love. From this moment on, all the conflicts that will confront the cities of Santa Cruz de Mompos and Nuestra Señora de La Candelaria del Banco appear, and separate the protagonists.

name: La costeña y el Cachaco
summary: Antonio Andrade is a Petroleum Engineer who is used to life in the capital, to living surrounded by luxury, but who, due to certain circumstances, is forced to move to the city of Santa Marta, where not everything is the same.

name: Go There
summary: Join the crew and go behind the scenes with CNN's reporters and correspondents stationed around the world with cameras in every corner of the planet. Your live, all-access pass to the most essential and visual news stories of the day.

name: In the Arena: Serena Williams
summary: In the Arena: Serena Williams provides the most complete, intimate, and compelling account of her legendary career, featuring firsthand perspective from Williams and key figures throughout her life.

name: Wizards Beyond Waverly Place
summary: Billie, a powerful young wizard, is sent to live in the mortal world with the only wizard teacher who can help her control her powers—Justin Russo.

name: Tucker on X
summary: Former Fox News host Tucker Carlson, who was controversially axed by the network in May 2023, has launched a new show on Twitter.

previousepisode.name: The Biden Administration Helped Install a Pro-Chinese Government in Brazil, Which Immediately Shut Down Opposition Media and Began Arresting Dissidents. Here Are Two of Its Victims.

name: Философское шоу
summary: In this show, we will deal with complex philosophical issues. Lisa will try to explain, and Igor will try to understand. A star guest will help them in the dispute over the birth of truth.

name: Welcome to the Lesbian Bar
summary: The lives of seven queer women intersect at a local lesbian bar as they meet, part, and share their colourful stories over a variety of equally colourful drinks.

name: Ask The Tech Guys
summary: Tech experts Leo Laporte and Mikah Sargent have the expertise to help you get the most out of your technology. From the latest gadgets to tried-and-true tech tips, tune into Ask The Tech Guys for an informative and fun look at tech. Call in with your live questions from 11 am-2 pm PT every Sunday at call.twit.tv. Get ready to level up your tech game! Records Sunday at 2:00pm Eastern / 11:00am Pacific / 18:00 UTC.

name: The Global Brief with Bianca Nobilo
summary: Bianca Nobilo brings the world to you. An essential global update from CNN's unparalleled team of international correspondents.

name: Murder at the Motel
summary: Formerly known as iconic, family-friendly interstate stops, many American motels have become places where transience and anonymity often go hand-in-hand. Murder at the Motel explores tragic murder cases set in motels and the pursuit to bring justice to the victims. The personal stories of the victims and of how the investigations unfolded are told from the perspective of family members and law enforcement officers who work tirelessly in their quest to solve these horrific crimes.

name: Roller Jam
summary: In this dynamic competition series, the best roller-skating teams from across the U.S. dance through the decades for a chance to win $150,000.

name: Second Chance Stage
summary: Second Chance Stage is a new kind of talent competition that offers contestants who have pushed their dreams aside for years, even decades, a second chance at their big break.

name: Human vs. Hamster
summary: In this innovative interspecies competition series, humans and hamsters square off in epic battles of skill, strength and agility for cash prizes.

previousepisode.name: Caroling Elves and Christmas Candy Clerks

name: Back to the Frontier
summary: Back to the Frontier transports participants to a meticulously recreated historical setting, challenging them to live and compete as pioneers. Contestants must perform tasks essential to frontier life, such as farming, building shelters and crafting tools, using only period-appropriate methods. They face environmental hardships, limited resources and the necessity of community cooperation. The show examines survival instincts, adaptability and the contrast between modern conveniences and historical realities, offering viewers an immersive historical experience.

name: Х-версии. Громкие дела
summary: There are questions the answers to which cannot be found either on the Internet or in the library. Crimes unsolved for many years, high-profile disasters, mysterious historical figures, cursed places that have ruined more than one life... Host of the X-version project. High-profile cases" Dmitry Shtokolov and famous psychics Fatima Khadueva, Mikhail Nevsky and Alexander Litvin take on any investigation.

name: Security Now
summary: Steve Gibson, the man who coined the term spyware and created the first anti-spyware program, creator of SpinRite and ShieldsUP, discusses the hot topics in security today with Leo Laporte.

name: MacBreak Weekly
summary: MacBreak Weekly covers all things Apple: Leo, Andy Ihnatko, Alex Lindsay, and Jason Snell analyze every bit of news from the most interesting company in tech. From AI to Vision Pro, iPad to iPhone, these Apple experts know-all and tell-all.

previousepisode.name: We're Making Them as Fast as We Can!

name: Tech News Weekly
summary: Industry expert Mikah Sargent, brings you interviews from tech journalists who make or break the top stories of the week. Get the freshest perspective and in depth insight into the fast-paced world of technology from Tech News Weekly. Records every Thursday at 2:00pm Eastern / 11:00am Pacific / 19:00 UTC.

name: Hard Knocks: Offseason with the New York Giants
summary: Hard Knocks: Offseason with the New York Giants will bring viewers inside the New York Giants organization as the team prepares for their highly anticipated 100th season. Camera crews will chronicle the team's every move as general manager Joe Schoen and other members of the team's front office and staff navigate the critical offseason period from January to July 2024, from the NFL Scouting Combine to free agency, to the NFL Draft, and team minicamps.

previousepisode.name: Offseason with the New York Giants #5

name: Youthful Glory
summary: After spending eight years defending the northern borders, Prince Jiang Xu returns to the royal court of the Daxian Dynasty to investigate the embezzlement of military funds from his army. In order to help his investigation, he proposes marriage to Ming Tan, a young woman from a distinguished military family, to shield her family from political exploitation. However, as Jiang Xu delves deeper into the case, he discovers that the embezzled funds are deeply intertwined with the Daxian Dynasty's entire economy – but as he works to dismantle the criminal network, the Ming family becomes scapegoats for the true masterminds. Can Jiang Xu clear his wife's family's name, and will his efforts bring him and Ming Tan closer than they ever expected to be? This drama was adapted from the novel "Little Cardamom" by Bu Zhi Shi Ke Cai.

name: Pull Strings
summary: Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

name: The Hawk
summary: Lonnie Hawkins, 2004's number one golfer, struggles on the back nine of his career to recapture his magic. His body says retire, but his heart says he's not done yet. His ex-wife and his son Lance, golf's new golden boy, know he's through. But with one more major to win to complete golf's Grand Slam, Lonnie refuses to believe he's anything other than one stroke away from the greatest comeback in golf history.

name: Nobody Wants This
summary: An agnostic sex podcaster and a rabbi walk into a party. No, it's not the start of a joke — it's the beginning of a love story. And it's complicated.

name: Laughter Chefs: Unlimited Entertainment
summary: An innovative blend of celebrity personalities, culinary skills, and comedy, all coming together for a delightful entertainment experience. This non-fiction show will feature six celebrity couples, each bringing their unique dynamic against a Kitchen Backdrop.

name: Suhagan Chudail
summary: Nishiganda is a 'chudail' and has an insatiable desire for immortality & the power to remain young & beautiful eternally. And every red moon night she sets out to hunt down men, wreck their relationship to marry them, and fulfill her desire to be the supreme. Who will be her next target?

name: Khubsurrat
summary: Khubsurrat is set in Mumbai and contrasts the lives of Navya, a resilient girl from the working-class chawls of Dadar East, and Naveli, a privileged but arrogant girl from affluent Cuffe Parade. Navya faces economic hardship and family prejudice due to her dark skin but remains optimistic and embodies the indomitable spirit of Mumbai. Their lives intertwine through Vihaan Oberoi, a wealthy but genuine man who secretly admires Navya's soulful voice on a radio show, unaware of her identity.

name: Running Point
summary: When a scandal forces her brother to resign, Isla Gordon is appointed President of the Los Angeles Waves, one of the most storied professional basketball franchises, and her family business. Ambitious and often overlooked, Isla will have to prove to her skeptical brothers, the board, and the larger sports community that she was the right choice for the job, especially in the unpredictable, male-dominated world of sports.

name: The Waterfront
summary: For decades, the Buckley family has ruled Havenport, North Carolina, dominating everything from the local fishing industry to the town's restaurant scene. But their fishing empire has started to crumble as patriarch Harlan Buckley recovers from two heart attacks, and his wife Belle and son Cane venture into the deep end to keep the family businesses afloat. As their attempts spiral out of control and into treacherous waters, Harlan steps back in to take command. Facing her own demons, Buckley daughter Bree — an addict in recovery who's lost custody of her son — finds herself entangled in a complicated relationship that could threaten the family's future forever. The series is inspired by true events.

name: Buckskin
summary: Life in a Montana town in the wild west days. Gentle family western Tommy Nolan narrated each episode while sitting on a corral fence playing his harmonica.

name: The Beauty Queen Killer: 9 Days of Terror
summary: In 1984, 16-year-old Tina Risico is kidnapped by a killer who takes her on a hellish road trip – and forces her to participate in a brutal crime.

name: The Strange Princess
summary: The mountain bandit king Ma Dayou kidnapped Princess Jiang Qian'er and was accidentally struck by lightning in the process. Miraculously, they swapped bodies and even shared each other's feelings, becoming intertwined in fate. Jiang Qian'er wanted to swap back and marry her beloved young general Lu Tianxing, and Ma Dayou also wanted to avenge his father. The two had no choice but to compromise with reality and cooperate to overcome various difficulties. Prince Ying secretly plotted a rebellion, sending people to infiltrate Ma Dayou's stronghold and take control of it for a secret military base. Jiang Qian'er, Ma Dayou, and Lu Tianxing moved into Prince Ying's mansion, each with their own goals: Jiang Qian'er to investigate the death of Ma Dayou's father and Lu Tianxing to find evidence of Prince Ying's treason. Prince Ying rebelled ahead of schedule, overthrowing the court, and leaving Jiang Qian'er homeless. Lu Tianxing was also forced by his treacherous father to marry Prince Ying's daughter, Jiang Kelan, to show loyalty. To deceive their way to safety, Jiang Qian'er, Ma Dayou, and Lu Tianxing pretended to be involved in a hilarious and tearful love triangle.

name: Смерти нет
summary: The first show about death that will change your life. TV-3 dared to challenge nature, science and prejudice in order to solve the main mystery of humanity - the mystery of death and eternal life...

name: Miss Night and Day
summary: A woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.

name: Вокруг света. Места силы
summary: Presenter Denis Grebenyuk goes to places from which people return healthy and "charged" with vital energy. He personally conducts a "test drive" of these places and shares his feelings.

name: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
summary: It is common knowledge that it is best to become an adventurer when you are as young as possible because the magical power that is the basis of an adventurer's strength will hardly grow if you don't train it while you are young. But this man, Rick Gladiator, who became an adventurer when he was over thirty years old, had the combat power of an S-rank adventurer, the highest rank in the world. In fact, Rick has lived an unimaginable life with the members of the legendary Orihalcon Fist, a party of the continent's strongest adventurers. From dragons to vampires, Rick's fighting prowess, trained by his literal "monster" mentors, allows him to defeat elite adventurers one after another who try to underestimate him.

name: Слежка
summary: People who want to find out the truth at any cost turn to the detective agency of Denis Grebenyuk and Grigory Kulagin. Even at the cost of invading someone else's privacy. The customer's consent, a cash deposit - and the "Surveillance" team establishes total video control over living "objects"...

name: NewsNation Prime
summary: America's source for unbiased news with the full range of perspectives across the country.

name: NewsNation Early Edition
summary:
"NewsNation Early Edition" will air weeknights 6 p.m. to 7 p.m. EST. Get breaking news, check in with NewsNation correspondents from around the nation and get the headlines as they happen so you can start your evening informed and in the know. Early Edition will also highlight Americans from all walks of life with specials showcasing trailblazers who are changing America for the better.

Berlie has served as NewsNation's weekend anchor since the newscast's launch last fall.

name: The Donlon Report
summary: Not telling viewers how to think, but giving viewers something to think about.

name: Rush Hour
summary: Anchored by Nichole Berlie.

name: United Gangs of America
summary: Current and former gang members reveal the innermost workings of some of the most dangerous gangs across the US.

name: Чародеи
summary: New Year is a magical time! In the pre-holiday week, "Sorcerers" will begin their work only on the "U" TV channel. They will save the desperate, make dreams come true, change destinies, and unravel the complex life situations of real people.

name: Большая вода
summary: The great rivers of Russia have always fed both nomads and Russian industrialists, who found the richest deposits of natural resources here. On their banks there appeared caves, underground tunnels and galleries, buildings and even cities hidden from view. The authors of the film set off on an exciting journey to find out what the Big Water of the largest rivers of our country hides from the world.

name: Quilos Mortais Brasil
summary: My 600lb Life Brazil follows the lives of men and women whose lives are severely affected because of their weight. For them, bariatric surgery is the only solution.

name: Sierra Madre: Prohibido Pasar
summary: In Latin America's richest municipality, a place where you have to be born to belong, Marcos Parra, a businessman blinded by ambition, will do anything to maintain his lifestyle and the apparent order of his community.

name: Dhawan Karenge with Shikhar Dhawan
summary: Join the dynamic Shikhar Dhawan as he switches gears from the cricket field to the talk show stage! Known for his desi charisma and electrifying batting style, Shikhar is all set to ignite the screen with his new talk show.

name: Temptation Island India
summary: Couples dip their toes in singleton life before deciding if they should stay faithful to their partners or give into temptation and embark on a whirlwind romance with new connections.

name: Iolo's Valleys
summary: From the industrial past to a remarkable rewilding. Iolo Williams explores the history, heritage and habitats of an abundance of wildlife in the south Wales valleys.

name: Feud
summary: The drama follows the story of Li Qingyue, the Goddess of Siling, and Bai Jiusi, the Grand Elder of Dacheng. Bound by a love-hate relationship, the two eventually overcome deep misunderstandings, endure trials together, and join forces to save the world.

name: The Lost National Treasure
summary: When Fang Kun, a graduate student in the Department of Archeology at Qinchuan University, was helping to recover cultural relics lost overseas, he discovered that a tomb in Yin Village, Bailuyuan, might be an unknown high-level imperial tomb. His mentor Zan Maochang took him to Bailuyuan for field investigation, but he accidentally lost his life. Fang Kun followed his mentor's last wish and grew up to be an archaeological team member. The unknown tomb in Yin Village attracted the attention of the archaeological community.

name: Fire Investigator
summary: In the heart of Qingdu City, a strange partnership takes shape between fire investigator Yu Tong and detective Lin Yao Yao after a string of odd fire incidents. They team up after a spontaneous combustion at a university campus, and soon, they're diving into a bunch of puzzling fire cases. With Yu Tong's special four-colour vision and Lin Yao Yao's sharp detective skills, they tackle the human dramas and social issues behind each fire they investigate. As they unravel the truth behind the fires, Yu Tong's hidden intelligence and grudge-filled past come to light, challenging Lin Yao Yao's by-the-book approach. Their differences cause tension, but as they learn more about each other, especially Yu Tong's painful history, they come together to seek justice. They face their own demons and uncover some shocking truths, including the surprising revelation that Yu Tong's girlfriend's brother is their ultimate foe.

name: Zhan Zhao Adventures
summary: Zhan Zhao, now a fourth-rank imperial guard, receives evidence from an old friend about an unsolved case and sets out on a quest to uncover the truth. He encounters attacks from various factions, and along the way, he meets Huo Linglong, the talented and unyielding daughter of Linglong Villa, and Bai Yutang, the passionate and ruthless "Golden-Haired Rat." These like-minded individuals pursue clues, fight for justice, apprehend criminals, and tear apart the web of influence Prince Xiang Yang has woven across the court and the underworld.

name: Above the Wall
summary: In the mid-to-late 1990s, Pinghai National cotton factory went bankrupt and liquidated, and the workers' resettlement fees were delayed. Rumors of corruption spread among the factory director Xiao Geng Shi. Worker Jiao Tong Sheng had been collecting evidence of Xiao Geng Shi's corruption, but drowned on a rainy night. Luo Shi Xiang, the police officer in charge of the case, quickly launched an investigation. After investigation, he found that Jiao Tong Sheng's death was related to his collection of evidence of corruption, and gradually locked in the suspect Xiao Geng Shi. At this time, Jiao Tong Sheng's daughter Lin Shuang Sheng began to silently check clues because she suspected her father's sudden drowning death, trying to provide effective evidence to the police.

name: When I Meet the Moon
summary: Shy and socially anxious Yun Li enrolls in graduate school to prove her independence and unexpectedly reunites with her high school crush, the brilliant Fu Shi Ze. Determined to win his heart, she steps out of her comfort zone and pursues him. Their love flourishes, but past traumas and personal differences drive them apart. Years later, Fu Shi Ze, now a renowned researcher, is determined to win Yun Li back when she returns from abroad. Through growth and perseverance, they find their way back to each other.

name: Het Conclaaf
summary: Seven political leaders come together to debate and stay together under the same roof for a weekend. During joint and individual conversations, they give the voter an insight into their beliefs and agenda.

name: Real Estate King
summary: Real Estate King billionaire real estate investor Grant Cardone searches America for the best deals found by local real estate wannabes who pitch him properties and their partnership, but only the best in each city will win full funding for their deal from the Real Estate King himself, Grant Cardone.

name: Pukaar - Dil Se Dil Tak
summary: A woman and her two daughters are separated from each other due to an evil man's sinister plan. Through the complex web of lies, betrayal, murder and a forbidden romance, can the sisters reunite with each other and their mother to avenge the death of their beloved father and husband?

name: Mishri
summary: Mishri is a tale of a young girl who is considered a lucky charm by her village. Mishri, who finds happiness in other's happiness is adored by her entire village, yearns for love and family. Her purpose in life is to fulfill her late father's dream to educate herself and make him proud. How will her life unfold when fate entangles her with Raghav and Vaani? How will Mishri fulfill her dreams and bring sweetness to her life?

name: Badall Pe Paon Hai
summary: An ambitious young girl from a small town dreams of a better life and fights tooth and nail to make it happen, including dabbling in the stock market. But with obstacles throughout her journey, can she achieve what she wants?

name: Косметический ремонт
summary:
The entertainment show "Cosmetic Repairs" (Russian: Косметический ремонт, romanized: Kosmeticheskiy remont) for the MUZ-TV channel is a Russian adaptation of the Endemol company's "Snog, Marry, Avoid" format.

Any person in this world can be made into a model of style and harmonious beauty. Metalheads, punks, freaks, lovers of "making everything sparkle and shimmer" will undergo a thorough tuning of their own appearance and turn into real handsome men and beauties.

The presenter of the show, Alexandra Rebenok, and the high-tech computer "POD" come to the aid of girls who are keen on "improving" their appearance. In a special "menu of changes", "POD" will offer you to choose options for hair color, hairstyle and style, and in accordance with them will select the most natural look.

name: Hidden Shadow
summary: Adapted from The Song Dynasty's Lady Assassin, the drama follows Mei Jiu (An Jiu), a quirky girl with dual souls, who joins the Crane Guards to find her missing mother. As An Jiu, she meets Chu Dingjiang, a young general weighed down by secrets, and together they fight through life and death. As Mei Jiu, she crosses paths with Hua Rongjian, a charming noble who falls deeply for her. Together with fellow agents—proud heiress Mei Tingyuan, medical genius Mo Sigui, and vengeance-driven Lou Mingyue—they grow and transform amid family feuds, national turmoil, and youthful passions.

name: Love in the Clouds
summary: At the annual Qingyun Conference in the Hexu Six Realms, Ji Bozai, a warrior from the Jixing Abyss with a past as a convict, defeated Ming Yi, the cold warrior goddess who had reigned supreme for seven consecutive years. Overnight, Ji Bozai became the hottest new star in Jixing Abyss. Meanwhile, Ming Yi, hiding her true identity, disguised herself as a dancer to get close to Ji Bozai. Under their carefully crafted personas, the two engaged in a thrilling dance of deception and attraction, fighting for justice and fairness, and ultimately found a deep and moving love.

name: The Biden Chronicles
summary: The Biden Chronicles takes an entertaining and no-holds-barred look at Joe Biden's presidency.

name: Х-версии. Колдуны мира
summary: Sorcerers from all over the world in one exclusive project. You will see secret rituals and sacred ceremonies right in your home.

name: Badi Heroine Banti Hai
summary: Advait and Kajal meet at his fashion house. Attraction and hate lead to drama as intern and boss become fake fiances to save his empire.

name: The Vendetta of An
summary: Xie Huai'an, son of the Huben Army's creator, survives his family's massacre. After ten long years in hiding, he returns to Chang'an disguised as a lowly registrar, moving step by step through jianghu clashes and palace power plays in a tense battle of wits to avenge his family and safeguard the realm.

name: Tujhpe Main Fida
summary: Aira's world is disrupted by the return of Marcus, who reconciles with her, restoring her lost happiness. As Cole Town faces mysterious deaths, Aira and Marcus must decide if their love can overcome the danger or be driven apart.

name: Inverted Fate
summary: A story about the love between Lin Chengyou, the son of King Cheng, and Teng Yuyi, the daughter of Jiangmen, involving past and present. Teng Yuyi was killed by a traitor, and when she woke up, she found that she had returned to the year before she was killed. Her cousin was not dead, her grandfather was still alive, and she accidentally obtained a "Xiaoya Sword" that can slay demons. With the help of this divine sword, Teng Yuyi embarked on the road of finding the truth. As a result, because of an encounter, she formed a relationship with Prince Cheng.

name: Practice Daughter
summary: As the daughter of the Prime Minister, Mei Yushan exchanges her life with Douzi, a skilled thief. With very different personalities and identities, they spark many hilarious stories in the process of exchanging their lives. How will Mei Yushan win over Nangong Yao, the Crown Prince of Jixi Kingdom, by showing a different charm as an "overbearing thief"? Will the cool and obsessive-compulsive Crown Prince be able to break the prophecy made by the National Master, Bai Ye, which predicts the crown prince's love will lead to the annihilation of Jixi Kingdom? Can he ultimately fulfill his respon?

name: NamaCool
summary: Mayank and Piyush, inseparable best friends, embark on their journey to uncover the true essence of manhood. However, yearning for popularity and romance, a chain of hilarious misfortunes thrusts them into the midst of a murder accusation.

name: Jam Jon Tai
summary: A young lawyer with an extraordinary memory confronts the hurdles of proving his father's innocence in the face of serious criminal accusations.

name: Doktrinen
summary: Journalist Nina Wedén gets the political scoop century and finds herself fast-tracked to becoming the Press Secretary for Sweden's newly appointed Foreign Minister, Jacob Weiss. As she gets closer to her new boss, Nina uncovers dark secrets that shed a sinister light on her path to this seismic career shift ; has she unwittingly become a pawn in a game that threaten the country's national security ? Set against the backdrop of the war in Ukraine, Nina will come uncomfortably close to Russian Intelligence operation to undermine Sweden's relationship with NATO.

name: Kwanruetai
summary: Chatklao started his work as a doctor for a hospital in camp to pay the loan back. He meets Kwanruetaiwho has always teased him. However, he finds himself in love with her. She is the daughter of Maratee and general Pinij who left nothing for her and mother after death. Maratee doesn't love her because of this. Kwanruetai really hates Chatklao because she was told that her family was brought down because of Juthathep family.

name: Atomic
summary: Atomic is a dynamic and entertaining action-fuelled adventure. When Max and Mohammed, two unlikely friends – and even less likely heroes – become swept up in a cartel's plot to transport uranium across North Africa, they face a monumental decision: save themselves or risk everything to prevent a nuclear bomb getting into the wrong hands.

name: Amber Girls School
summary: Ojas, a 15-year-old, student of 9th grade chases her dream to be the Head Girl. This puts her in direct conflict with her desire to explore all things teenage. Will she pursue her Head Girl dream or find her voice through this journey?

name: The Point of Mo Return
summary: An exclusive first-look at Mo and Freddie's decision to return home will premiere on the EastEnders TikTok channel in a limited series, following both characters in Mo's caravan where she has been living ever since leaving Walford.

name: Темная сторона
summary:
Who casts spells on celebrities? Why do the most exemplary families collapse after 20 years of marriage and is it possible to protect yourself from the evil eye? Where are the sources of strength and why do so-called "black spots" literally attract people to them? How long does the curse last and how can I get rid of it?

Viewers will learn about settlements whose residents are terrified to leave their homes because they believe that everything around them is infested with ghosts. About generations of people who, for decades, cannot remove the curse from their family. About houses standing on fissures leading to the other world.

The expulsion of demons and crimes covered in mystery, the search for the living and the unsolved signs of the dead - the documentary-mystical project "The Dark Side" will tell about this.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 6. Любовные неудачи Даны Борисовой, новая Ванга и экспедиция со смертельным исходом

name: Land of Tanabata
summary: Yoji Minamimaru, with a unique ability, finds his professor missing, thrust into a gripping mystery.

name: House on Fire
summary: Category is: Family Realness! Follow the chosen family of the legendary House of Miyake-Mugler, as they juggle their impressive careers, steamy relationships, and heated rivalries, all while slaying the fierce world of New York City ballroom!

name: Europe's Wild Places
summary: A vibrant trip through Europe's natural beauty, rich biodiversity, and unique ecosystems. Explore the landscape of endless coasts, deep into ancient forests, high up in the mountains and along the frigid arctic circle. Frozen Wonderland: The deep snow of winter can bring hardships and life centers around surviving the bitter cold. Wolves and lynx hunt for their next meal, wolverines scavenge and mountain goats face an avalanche. A New Day: Spring and summer in Europe bring babies. From barnacle geese learning to fly from high cliffs in Greenland, to brown bears and great gray owls teaching their little ones about life in the forests.

name: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
summary:
From traditional Irish stew to soda bread, fresh seafood, and boxty potato pancakes - Dermot will taste his way across the island, meeting the chefs and locals that champion and celebrate Ireland's gastronomic heritage. 

Having opened two of his own fish-themed restaurants and sharing some of his favourite home recipes on ITV's This Morning, he is now taking his passion on the road whilst exploring Ireland's ancient landscapes, diverse cities and stunning coastlines. 

From Michelin Star restaurants in the ‘Gourmet Capital of Ireland' Kinsale; to fishing for oysters by the sea in Cork; sitting down for some home-grown comfort food in Wexford; and exploring the buzz of the Dublin food scene; before venturing across to Northern Ireland and the bustling city of Belfast and beyond - Dermot's Taste of Ireland promises to be a foodie delight, full of surprises.

name: Juke Box Jury
summary: Classic 1950s and 60s pop music show in which a panel votes hit or miss on the new releases they are played.

previousepisode.name: Monie Love, Dusty Springfield, Rowland Rivron, Bob Geldof

name: Gôsuto yankî
summary: Follows a boy who has lost all hope in life and encounters a group of "Showa Ghost Yankees" with unique personalities.

name: Forever, Interrupted
summary: Elsie and Ben's whirlwind romance is electric – within months they're married and living happily ever after – when Ben's unexpected death forces Elsie to come face to face with Susan, the mother-in-law who doesn't know that she exists. Told through a dual timeline, the series recounts Elsie and Ben's once-in-a-lifetime love, intercut with Elsie and Susan's unexpected journey as their at first turbulent connection ultimately brings both women cathartic new beginnings.

name: Lobbet Hob
summary: A young girl in distress, hired for money, must trick a businessman into falling in love with her and getting married.

name: Al Kha'en
summary: Dr. Aseel's perfect life is shattered when she discovers that her husband Seif is having an affair. Her subsequent quest for vengeance takes her down a dark path.

name: Black Out
summary:
Jung Woo is a straight-A student, loved by his community, and has already been accepted into medical school by early admissions. However, the day after the national college entrance exam, he is arrested on the charge of murdering two of his female classmates.

Ten years later, Jung Woo is now a 30-year-old young man. Having served out his sentence, he is released from prison and returns home. The town has completely changed, and he vows to leave to begin a new life, but odd things keep happening to him and around him, preventing him from leaving.

name: Uki
summary: The cheerful Uki learns something new every day.

name: Law-less
summary: A former gangster turned lawyer, who seeks to avenge his mother and fight against those with absolute power, joins forces with a lawyer of high integrity, who works with him after she is suspended for assaulting a judge. Together, they use the law to fight for justice against a corrupt judge and her associates.

name: When the Phone Rings
summary: Korea's youngest presidential spokesperson finds his cold, calculated three-year marriage thrown into questions when his wife, a sign language interpreter, is mysteriously abducted.

name: Lucky Luke
summary: Lucky Luke tells the story of the legendary, lonely cowboy who must help Louise, an eighteen-year-old girl as endearing as she is unpredictable. Together, they embark on a quest across the Wild West to find Louise's mother, who has mysteriously disappeared… while thwarting a plot that could change the course of U.S. history! Between duels, chases, furious balls and unexpected alliances with the Daltons, Billy the Kid or Calamity Jane, our unlikely duo will discover that the biggest challenge is not to save America… but to team up! A thrilling adventure where the man who shoots faster than his shadow will have to face the ghosts of his past and confront the origins of his legend.

name: Amandaland
summary:
Following three series of the Merman-produced, BAFTA award-winning series Motherland, a brand-new spin-off, Amandaland, is coming to the BBC, focused on Amanda.

Post her divorce, Amanda has had to downsize and up sticks to South Harlesden, or as the Estate Agent calls it SoHa (definitely not the area around Wormwood Scrubs prison).

With both Manus and Georgie now at secondary school, Amanda has to try and get her head around raising teenagers, dealing with modern motherhood horrors like teenage drinking, fake Instagram accounts and eco anxiety. Not even a woman as certain of her parenting as Amanda can deal with these nightmares alone.

Then there's Amanda's mother Felicity who is constantly around, and completely in denial that she is, in fact, lonely. Theirs is a slightly unhealthy co-dependent relationship based on backhanded compliments and veiled snipes about her new home.

After a brief spell of freedom, Anne is sucked back into being Amanda's minion to help her navigate the social scene with the other parents at the children's new school. Thank God for Anne.

name: A Killer Makes a Call
summary:
A 999 call comes into the emergency services reporting a murder. Is it a traumatised witness who survived? A distressed loved one who finds the aftermath? Or is it the chilling voice of the killer?

In this series we focus on shocking murder cases where the person who makes the call is actually the murderer. In each episode we unravel the sequence of events that lead up to the call and then the investigation that follows to determine the identity of the murderer and how they were caught. In every case the call is a key piece of evidence as the police piece together the case and get justice for the victim.

name: Takara no Vidro
summary: Taishin has moved to Tokyo from his hometown of Fukuoka in order to reunite with Takara, a stranger who had consoled him in his grief the year prior. However, despite finally getting a chance to express his gratitude to Takara at college, he is given the cold shoulder! But Taishin, undeterred, decides to pursue Takara anyway, and Takara finds himself becoming more and more enchanted by Taishin's straightforward and earnest gaze.

name: The Leventhal Report
summary: Rick Leventhal, known for his dynamic reporting style and in-depth coverage of breaking stories, hosts a captivating news show delivering the latest updates on significant events from around our nation and the world. Leventhal uses his decades of experience to give viewers comprehensive analysis and compelling interviews with key figures at the forefront of current affairs.

name: Life of Cards
summary: Life of Cards offers a thrilling insight into the lifestyles of ten of the best professional poker players in the world.

name: Ochibi-san
summary: "I can help you laugh, but I can't take away the tears you've shed." In Mametsubu-cho, a town somewhere in the ancient Japanese city of Kamakura, Ochibi-san lives a relaxed, easy life. With his friend Nazeni the dog, Jack the naughty kitten, and Pankui the hungry dog, Ochibi-san's year in Mametsubu-cho is filled with encounters and new discoveries! Flower-viewing in spring, swimming in summer, collecting leaves in fall, and eating yummy food in winter.

name: One Off
summary:
A slice of life of high school girls in the early summer. Shiozaki Haruno is a 17-year-old girl who loves her motor cycle, HONDA's Giorno. She lives in remote highlands and longs for a vivid life in a city.

Encounters with people staying at Haruno's parents' boardinghouse encourage her to step forward to her dream.

name: Fei Ren Zai
summary: Jiu Yue is a nine-tailed fox spirit who is more than two centuries old. She faces her hardest challenge yet: trying to adapt to the modern world. Knowing she needs money to survive, she starts working at a company—only to realize her coworkers are just as mythical as her! As Jiu Yue and her new friends attempt to fit in, their non-human sides make even the most trivial situations take a ridiculous turn.

name: Twende
summary: Twende is a pangolin, which is the slowest-moving animal in the Savannah. His belief that 'life is about the journey, not the destination' is at odds with his job as a boda boda driver in the busy, fictional African city of Milima.

name: Betsy's Kindergarten Adventures
summary: The show follows a five-year-old girl named Betsy as she starts out her school years. The series premiere shows Betsy facing the uncertainty of her first day of school and the adjustments she must make as she meets her new teacher and classmates, encounters unfamiliar rules and routines, and finds herself in an entirely new environment. Subsequent episodes show Betsy's excitement and sense of adventure as she adapts to the new experiences of kindergarten.

name: Keys to the VIP
summary: Set in Toronto's nightclub scene, this game show pits man against man in the game of seduction. Two players go head-to-head for three rounds where they test their skills at winning over women in the real-life battlefield of a club. There are four judges who decide the winner and critique the player's games.

name: Lone Wolf & Cub
summary: The adventures of a samurai and his young son.

name: Extra
summary: Catherine, mother and choir director of an inclusive choir, sets out, unbeknownst to her family, to conquer pleasure through sexual support for people with disabilities.

name: Zamanın Kapıları
summary: The doors of the past open one by one when the path of the computer genius Sinan, who lives an asocial life without communicating as much as possible with people despite the opportunities he has, crosses with Nevra, the attractive beautiful daughter of one of the most important businessmen in Turkey. With the secrets revealed, Nevra also encounters her own reality. Together they embark on a tense journey towards their roots. The confrontation and passionate love they will experience will bring many disasters and deaths...

name: Baahubali: Crown of Blood
summary: A dark chapter in the Mahishmati kingdom's history that became its greatest challenge and shaped the future of its two princes, Baahubali and Bhallaladeva. When the great kingdom of Mahishmati faces repeated attacks from an unknown foe, all signs point to a mysterious warlord.

name: Baituo! Gege Fangguo Wo
summary: Shen Nian is looking for her missing brother, who left her a pendant. She meets a handsome guy in a bar and falls in love with him, then suddenly finds out he is her brother

name: Outback Outlaw Comedian
summary: Pauly and his new crew, bodyguard Lee Priest, dancers Tayla and Sam along with tour manager Leah hit the road touring Pauly's stand-up comedy show to the most remote venues of outback Australia.

name: Unsettled Case
summary: One cold case per unit, two units per season. The debut season of Unsettled Case focuses on two units: "The Jewelry Store Serial Robbery" and "The Bianji Hotel Robbery." Within a time rift that moves against the grain, it deconstructs how crime reshapes a person, while also telling a story of how faith can redeem a soul.

name: Les Belles
summary:
Luo Lingyu, a fallen noblewoman, travels to Jianye with her sister to seek refuge. On the way, she rescues a destitute man but later forces him to jump overboard due to societal norms.
Unaware that the Lu family's third young master is the man she pushed into the water, she tries to win his favor—only to be repeatedly thwarted. He watches her struggle, exposing her every move, yet when she turns to someone else, he refuses to let her go!

name: Close Proximity
summary: Close Proximity dives into a world of cars, trucks and tire burn, through the unique life of professional, drift car driver, Matt Field.

name: Dream Star Fighting MARIGOLD
summary: Dream Star☆Fighting Marigold is the next step in the evolution of women's professional wrestling, not just in Japan, but around the world. A reflection of joshi puroresu's past, connecting the culture of women's professional wrestling from yesterday and today, and leading a revolution into the future. Follow our dream warriors as they shine in the golden garden!

name: Viktor Bringt's
summary: Moritz Bleibtreu plays the opinionated Berlin service technician Viktor, who has to come to terms with his son Mika. Together, they deliver electrical appliances and get into ludicrous discussions with customers about the big and small questions of life.

name: Perfekt Verpasst
summary: The first series with Anke Engelke and Bastian Pastewka. Maria and Ralf are both stuck in their lives. Together, however, they would be the absolute dream team - if only they would finally meet ...

name: Do You Wanna Partner
summary: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs by starting a beer brand, diving into the bro-iest industry ever. But when their path to glory is blocked by those who think beer, business and women just don't mix, they are forced to use some rather unconventional methods - only to land them in further chaos amidst beer barons, mobsters and a monster of their own making.

name: Young DAVID
summary: Step into the world of Young DAVID, a 5-part animated mini-series that explores the formative years of legendary King David. Delve into his humble beginnings as a shepherd, his love for playing the lyre and composing poetry, his fateful encounter with the king's shepherd, and his daring race to save his sheep from a fearsome lion. This heartwarming tale reveals the makings of a future king, long before he faced any giants or ascended the throne.

name: Tuttle Twins
summary: Kids, economics, and freedom. All mashed together in one show. Join Grandma Gabby as she takes her twin grandkids on wheelchair time-machine adventures to learn about the virtues America was founded on. Tuttle Twins teaches your teens, tweens, and toddlers about the principles of freedom, government, and economics in a hilariously entertaining way.

previousepisode.name: Dark Dumpster Derek and the Gold Grabbers

name: Hip-Hop Houdini
summary: Street magic meets hip-hop music in this series, which features magician Tomas B. De la Cruz Jr. -- aka Smoothini -- wowing today's top artists with his unique tricks. He meets guests including Lil Jon, Waka Flocka Flame, Fat Joe, Iggy Azalea and Becky G, and by disarming them with his slight of hand, he gets to know them and reveals something about each artist that even the most ardent fans didn't know. Episodes conclude with Smoothini, who has appeared on "America's Got Talent" and entertained crowds for years in Las Vegas, unveiling a custom-designed illusion for the artists.

name: Русские каникулы
summary: 13-year-old Victor, 14-year-old Neva and 18-year-old Lucas grew up in Europe, and this will be their first trip across the vast expanses of Russia. They want to understand what it means to be Russian, and to do this they will immerse themselves in the environment, study the national character and get acquainted with the cultural characteristics of Russia. They will make their way through the Caucasus Mountains and then go to the Russian North, and the writer Mikhail Zygar will become their guide on this journey.

name: Gibbsville
summary: Stories of a Pennsylvania mining town in the forties seen through the eyes of two journalists.

name: John Bachman Now
summary: John Bachman Now shares breaking news and informed commentary and analysis from a broad range of top experts.

name: America's News Headquarters with Ed Henry
summary: Ed Henry delivers the latest headlines and interviews with politicians and other national newsmakers.

name: National Desk
summary: National Desk

name: Newswire
summary: A daily sports program covering the top headlines, breaking news and injury reports in professional and collegiate sports.

name: The Todd Starnes Show
summary: Todd Starnes delivers breaking news and commentary covering politics, faith, and culture

name: Ed Henry The Briefing
summary: Catch the latest headline and in-depth analysis on The Briefing, your go-to news show for a comprehensive afternoon update, with a dynamic blend of breaking news, politics, and business.

name: David Harris Jr The Pulse
summary: David Harris Jr delivers hard hitting analysis and opinion of latest news and events.

name: America's Mayor Live
summary: Former NY Mayor Rudy Giuliani gives insight on leadership, courage, and the most pressing issues of our time.

previousepisode.name: (1025): President Trump Hosts China's President Xi Jinping with a State Dinner

name: The Freedom File: Judge Napolitano
summary: Hard hitting legal/political news from a man who knows and respects the Constitution and the importance of defending individual freedoms.

name: Salcedo Live
summary: Liberty-loving host Chris Salcedo tackles all things politics from a constitutional conservative point of view.

name: The Wendy Bell Show
summary: Conservative. American. Strong. Veteran broadcaster Wendy Bell dives into big news from across America, and around the world.

name: NBC News NOW Live with Alison Morris
Legends of the Ramayana with Amish
summary: Acclaimed author Amish Tripathi traverses 5,000 kilometers in the footsteps of Rama, India's biggest cultural hero. He travels to key locations, mapping myth with geology, customs and belief to bring the legends of Rama's travels alive.

name: Into The Wild with Bear Grylls
summary: Bear Grylls takes India's most well-known celebrities deep into the Indian jungles. They have to survive in the wild with nothing more than they have. There are surprise packages along the route that present new challenges.

name: Love Kills: Madhumita Shukla Hatyakand
summary: This hard-hitting investigative series looks at the world of grisly murders in India. These stories of revenge, jealously and greed are broken down to reveal what actually happened to lead to a gruesome killing.

name: History Hunter
summary: Discover the quest to unearth fascinating stories and unexplained mysteries from India's history. Manish Paul is on the hunt to explore the unexplained from hundreds of years ago, which continues to elude us to this day.

name: I Should Have Stayed Home
summary: Two travelling brothers are stranded in a remote location and find away to return home. Without access to technology, they must rely on their own navigation, survival skills, and vehicle.

name: Хроники ломбарда
summary: Every day another mystery occurs in the pawnshop - the appearance of a unique item. Only the eye of an experienced buyer can identify it from hundreds of other items.

name: The Michael Knowles Show
summary: Bask in the simple joys of being right. The Michael Knowles Show cuts through the madness of our politics and culture, analyzing the top stories of the day. Monday-Friday at 8:30AM CT.

name: The Matt Walsh Show
summary: Fed up with the talking heads? Matt gives you a no-holds-barred take on today's cultural, religious, and political issues. Monday-Friday at 12:30PM CT.

name: The Andrew Klavan Show
summary: Laugh your way through Armageddon with political satire, cultural commentary, interviews and relentless mockery of modern absurdities. Friday at 6PM CT.

previousepisode.name: 1286 - Crisis to the Left and Right

name: The Ben Shapiro Show
summary: Tune in to the fastest growing, hardest hitting, most insightful, and savagely irreverent conservative podcast on the web. Monday-Friday at 10AM CT.

name: Dress My Tour
summary: Dress My Tour takes fans behind the curtain of the unpredictable fashion and music industries. The series follows 11 aspiring fashion designers on the raw, emotional journey of creating stunning fashion pieces worthy of the music world's biggest names like JoJo Siwa, Paula Abdul, Toni Braxton, Ty Dolla $ign and more. As these designers compete to make their mark in the fashion and music industries, find out which one of them truly has what it takes to design for the stars and win the $100,000 prize.

name: Убойный отпуск
summary: Lyuba and Roma are tired of their marriage, but their pregnant daughter Nastya and son-in-law Styopa decide to help their parents save their family and give them a tour to a five-star hotel in Turkey. They agree so as not to upset their daughter, but they don't think about any restoration of the relationship. On the contrary, Lyuba quarrels with Roma on the plane, demands a divorce, at the very first dinner begins to flirt with a handsome Turkish man, drinks too much, and in the morning discovers a corpse in her bed.

name: Secrets of the Koh-i-noor
summary: A historical journey traces the steps of the world's most fabled diamond -- the Koh-i-noor. Explore the insatiable lust for the famous diamond, which shaped the course of history through significant bloody wars, empowered rulers and ruined dynasties.

name: Ananth Anaadih Vadnagar
summary: Discover the original inhabitants of Vadnagar that built foundations of trade, culture, economy, religion and spirituality.

name: Dangals of Crime
summary: Dangals of Crime digs beneath the surface to explore Indian wrestling's insidious links to violence and crime, and whether the sport can repair its tarnished reputation and find a way back to its ideals of fairness and honour.

name: Dark Mysteries: Anjaan Kahaniyaan
summary: Embark on a journey across India in the search of the unexplained. Through the series, we will track a range of mysteries covering themes like black magic, reincarnations, curses, ghost stories.

name: Breaking Point
summary: Breaking Point showcases the blood, sweat and tears of young soldiers of the Indian Armoured Corp, Army Aviation, The Paratroopers and The Artillery during their extreme training.

name: Celebrity Family Food Battle
summary: Hollywood celebrities team up with family members in a cooking competition that puts their culinary knowledge, or lack thereof, to the test. In each episode, host Manolo Gonzalez Vergara welcomes two teams to the Celebrity Family Food Battle kitchen, where they are challenged to create dishes inspired by popular films and TV shows. With the coveted Golden Fork Award and money for their chosen charities at stake, the celebrity contestants will put it all on the line to impress the judges.

name: Agents of Mystery
summary: Six Korean celebs become field agents for a secret organization. Will they be able to team up to complete their paranormal mission within six hours?

name: Except You
summary: Except You follows Erica, who can't help but fall in love with everyone she meets. When her ambitious ex, an FBI agent who used Erica's infatuations to get closer to criminals, goes rogue, she'll have to help the Feds track down her ex, one mortifying crush at a time.

name: Ιωάννης Καποδίστριας
summary: A dramatized documentary series dedicated to the life and work of Ioannis Kapodistrias, one of the most emblematic figures of modern Hellenism and the first governor of the independent Greek state.

name: Ο Κώδικας της Τέχνης
summary: The 13-episode TV documentary series created for COSMOTE History, reveals the unknown history of 75 selected Greek sculpture, painting, pottery and gold jewelry. Each episode will have a central theme, such as the sea, the stranger, the musical accompaniment, the loss, the defeat, the craving, universal Greece.

name: Gods of Food
summary: Food is art, and art is food. In this spicy mockumentary, we meet six of the world's most revolutionary chefs -- each redefining the dining experience.

name: 17 Κλωστές
summary: Based on novel "17 Κλωστές", which is based on real events about the biggest mass murder in Hellenic modern history.

previousepisode.name: Δεν έκανα εγώ το κακό. Εγώ το διόρθωσα

name: Η Γενιά του '30
summary: 15 dramatized biographies/studies of the prose writers and poets of the Generation of the '30s, the landmark generation of modern Hellenic culture, narrating the historical events of the period which inevitably affected both the authors and their works.

name: No One is Leaving Palo Alto
summary: When an extra, eleventh body turns up in the anatomy lab of Haifa's Technion Medical Department, lead detective Iris Abramov is thrust into a case that's far from routine. Amid a messy divorce and her father's resistance to assisted living, Iris dives into a tangled web of greed, gentrification, and racial tensions threatening to unsettle the entire city of Haifa. Based on the best-selling novel No One Leaves Palo Alto by Yaniv Iczkovits.

name: Corpse Party: Tortured Souls
summary: Corpse Party is set in Heavenly Host Elementary School, an elementary school that was torn down following the murders and disappearances of several of its staff and students. By the start of the story, another school called Kisaragi Academy has been built over the elementary school site. One night, a group of students from Kisaragi are transported via a sudden earthquake to another dimension where Heavenly Host Elementary still exists and is haunted by the ghosts of the school's murdered children. The player takes control of the Kisaragi students as they try to find their way home and survive the other mysterious forces that haunt the school.

name: Kingpins
summary: Filmmaker Ben Zand travels around the globe to find out what everyday life is like for notorious criminals, getting unprecedented access to their world as well as coming face to face with the dark consequences of their actions.

name: Eno
summary: Eno follows a family of three sisters who are pushed by their mother, Abena Baafi the matriarch, into the path of wealthy suitors. But the girls all have minds of their own, and their mother's dream quickly turns into their worst nightmare.

name: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
summary: Not even a hero, Takumi Iruma gets accidentally mixed in with a group of heroes chosen to be summoned to another world. As compensation for the mix-up, a goddess offers him the right to choose any skill he wishes for! Hoping for a peaceful and quiet life that has nothing to do with fighting or going into battle, he chooses a seemingly boring creation skill. However, it turns out "alchemy" is the most powerful skill that allows him to create everything from a holy sword to flying ships! This cheat skill he unexpectedly acquired turns him into a wealthy merchant and makes him undefeatable in battles! A heartwarming adventure story about (possibly) the most powerful alchemist in another world!

name: Scariest House in America
summary: Comedian Retta travels across the country to courageously tour homes full of haunts, frights and scares. After crowning the most terrifying house of them all, designer Alison Victoria surprises the homeowners with a scary-good $150,000 renovation!

name: How Music Got Free
summary: How Music Got Free details the fascinating, and often funny, inside story of the technology-driven disruption that changed music during the late-90s and early-2000s. File sharing technology, combined with the insatiable demand for new music, created both the means and the motive for millions of young people to participate in outright theft – and be celebrated for it.
